theme_strategy: Precision Engineering & Power Infrastructure — High-contrast editorial light mode with deep forest green structural anchors, dark slate charcoal panels, engineering safety orange kinetic triggers, and technical grid aesthetics.

rules.mono_labels: font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#FF5500]

entry_surfaces./: split hero — kinetic masked typography + KPI badge left, dynamic 765kV transmission tower visual & EPC beacon right
entry_surfaces./about: editorial manifesto layout — dual era cards (2014-2025 subcontract vs 2025-present full EPC) + leadership grid
entry_surfaces./services: modular technical catalog — 8 specialized transmission & substation service cards with technical scope modals
entry_surfaces./projects: curated EPC portfolio matrix — split into Flagship 765kV EPC, historical subcontract execution (7 projects) & recent works
entry_surfaces./epc-capabilities: step-by-step EPC engineering roadmap — 9-stage execution pipeline (Survey to Commissioning) with technical milestones
entry_surfaces./experience: chronological infrastructure timeline (2014 to present) with verified package data & partner ecosystem
entry_surfaces./quality-hse: dark tactical HSE control center — Golden Safety Rules, zero-incident protocol, and PPE compliance standards
entry_surfaces./careers: talent acquisition board — current infrastructure openings, company safety culture, and direct application form
entry_surfaces./contact: split corporate contact center — dual offices (Bihar Registered + Karnataka EPC site) and backend-connected enquiry form

visual_enhancers.grid_pattern: Technical CAD-style engineering grid background (dots or fine 1px grid lines with 5% opacity)
visual_enhancers.transmission_motifs: Angular steel lattice patterns, electrical busbar diagrams, voltage badges (765 kV, 400 kV, 220 kV, 132 kV, 66 kV, 33 kV)
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon featuring key capabilities: TOWER ERECTION • 765 KV TRANSMISSION • RE-CONDUCTORING • HTLS • GIS SUBSTATIONS • CIVIL FOUNDATIONS • FULL EPC EXECUTION
visual_enhancers.kpi_strip: High-impact counter metrics with management asterisk (*): Established 2014 | 765 kV Max Voltage | 35 km Flagship EPC | Up to 3,000 Project Manpower* | 50+ km Cumulative Experience*

grids_and_layouts.bento_mode: Tetris Grid (asymmetric 12-column grid for showcase sections)

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling integrated at top level layout
motion.hero_reveal: Line-by-line staggered text mask reveal (y: 100% to 0%, duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1])
motion.hover_effects: Card subtle elevation translate-y-1 + 1px border glow to #FF5500/40
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system settings with fallback instantaneous transitions

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large graphical components)
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, forms, CTA buttons, tabs, modal triggers, and KPI cards must include kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='nav-request-discussion-btn', data-testid='enquiry-form-submit-btn')
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria attributes for accordions, modals, and navigation drawers

component_structure.voltage_spectrum_band: frontend/src/components/VoltageBand.tsx (Interactive 33kV to 765kV range selector with technical specs)

Do not invent direct-client claims for subcontract packages (clearly mark as 'Subcontract / Execution Partner for EPC Prime').
